Manage profile records (no login, no provider launch)

Usage: larp cc profile <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Register a profile and create its empty state directory
  list    List profiles
  show    Show one profile
  rename  Rename a profile; its ID and state directory do not change
  forget  Remove a profile from the registry; its state directory is kept

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
